narrative_purpose: The cold-open anchor: a ridge view across unbroken rainforest to the Eastern Sea, with a level band of cloud across the sky - the lush sameness that the chapter sets out to explain.
subject: A high rocky ridge in the foreground with a lone observer's vantage, looking out over endless rolling bioluminescent rainforest that runs unbroken to a distant shoreline. Beyond the shore a wide calm sea stretches to the horizon. Above the horizon a single long, level band of thick bright cloud lies parallel to the skyline, as if drawn with a ruler.
scene: Twilight on Pandora, humid air, layered ridgelines fading into haze, faint glowing spores drifting in the foreground air.
camera: Wide establishing landscape from the ridge, eye level looking out and slightly down over the canopy to the sea.
light: Soft ambient dusk; the forest canopy carries a faint living-teal glow; the cloud band catches a cool highlight.
palette: Dominant cool teals and void-indigo across forest and sea, misty-cyan cloud band, a scarce warm amber glint low on the horizon.
style: Painterly naturalist landscape plate, atmospheric depth, soft brushed canopy texture, NOT a photo or 3D render.
detail_level: High in the near canopy and ridge, dissolving into layered haze toward the sea and sky.
composition: Strong horizontal layering - ridge, canopy, sea, level cloud band - emphasising how the forest and the cloud band both run flat to the horizon.
consistency_notes: Match the moon's palette and cloud-band motif from fig-00-cover. The level cloud band is the same Intertropical Convergence Zone seen later in the diagrams.
negative_prompt: no text, no lettering, no numbers, no labels, no arrows, no diagram chrome, no UI, no photographic or 3D-render look, no lens flares
